artifacts.label: evaluation-prep-progress
artifacts.note: Emitted during PREP phase execution. data.step indicates current step name (e.g. 'resolveEmployee', 'curateMetrics', 'planRun').

artifacts.label: evaluation-prep-done
artifacts.note: Emitted when PREP phase completes. data.next_trigger contains the exact message frontend must send to start the first TC. Frontend only needs to send data.next_trigger — no queue management required.

data_schema.next_trigger: string — e.g. '执行测试用例 tc-001'，frontend sends this verbatim

artifacts.label: evaluation-run-progress
artifacts.note: Emitted while executing a single TC. data.phase is 'driving' during STEP 3 or 'scoring' during STEP 4.

artifacts.label: evaluation-tc-done
artifacts.note: Emitted when a single TC completes STEP 3+4. data.next_trigger is the exact next message frontend must send — either '执行测试用例 <next_tc_id>' for the next TC, or '生成评估报告' when all TCs are done. Frontend only needs to send data.next_trigger verbatim. Skill manages the queue.

data_schema.next_trigger: string — '执行测试用例 tc-004' OR '生成评估报告' when all done

artifacts.label: evaluation-report-done
artifacts.note: Emitted when REPORT phase completes. next_trigger is null — this is the terminal event of the whole pipeline.

orchestration_contract.description: Skill 管理执行队列，前端只做监听和发送。前端规则：收到任何 terminal artifact 后，读取 data.next_trigger，若非 null 则原样发送，若为 null 则停止。
orchestration_contract.frontend_rule: 收到 terminal artifact → 读 data.next_trigger → 非 null 则发送，null 则停止。仅此一条规则，无需其他逻辑。
orchestration_contract.skill_responsibility: Skill 负责在每个 terminal artifact 的 next_trigger 字段中填入正确的下一条消息。Skill 通过扫描 run_plan.json 和已完成的 summary 文件确定下一个待执行的 tc_id。
flow_example: skill → eval_prep_done { next_trigger: '执行测试用例 tc-001' }
skill → eval_tc_done { next_trigger: '执行测试用例 tc-002', completed_count: 1, total_count: 10 }
skill → eval_tc_done { next_trigger: '生成评估报告', completed_count: 10, total_count: 10 }
orchestration_contract.error_handling: 若出现 eval_error artifact（terminal: true，next_trigger: null），前端停止发送，展示错误，等待用户操作。

error_artifact.label: evaluation-error
error_artifact.note: Emitted on fatal error. next_trigger is always null.

artifacts.label: evaluation-prep-progress
artifacts.note: Emitted during PREP phase execution. data.status must be 'running'. data.step indicates current step name (e.g. 'resolveEmployee', 'curateMetrics', 'planRun').

artifacts.label: evaluation-prep-done
artifacts.note: Emitted when PREP phase completes (run_plan.json written). data must include: eval_id, employee_display_name, role_id, tc_count (int), tc_list (array of {tc_id, display_name, opening_message_head}), selected_metrics_count (int). Frontend uses tc_list to build an execution queue and dispatches 「执行测试用例 <tc_id>」 for each TC sequentially — one session per TC.

artifacts.label: evaluation-run-progress
artifacts.note: Emitted during RUN phase while executing a single TC. data must include: eval_id, tc_id, tc_display_name, turn_index (current turn), phase ('driving' | 'scoring'), completed_count (int), total_count (int).

artifacts.label: evaluation-tc-done
artifacts.note: Emitted when a single TC completes STEP 3+4. data must include: eval_id, tc_id, tc_display_name, turns_used (int), termination_reason, metric_scores (object: metric_code -> score), completed_count (int), total_count (int). Frontend pops next tc_id from its queue and dispatches 「执行测试用例 <next_tc_id>」. When queue is empty, frontend dispatches 「生成评估报告」.

artifacts.label: evaluation-report-progress
artifacts.note: Emitted during REPORT phase. data must include: eval_id, step (e.g. 'aggregating', 'rollup', 'redline', 'scenario_reports', 'overall_report', 'uploading'), completed_steps (int), total_steps (int, fixed at 6).

artifacts.label: evaluation-report-done
artifacts.note: Emitted when REPORT phase completes. data must include: eval_id, overall_score (int 0-100), passed (bool), dimension_scores (object: dimension -> score), report_json_path, report_html_path, uploaded (bool). This is the terminal artifact — frontend shows report viewer.

orchestration_contract.description: 前端驱动的三阶段编排协议。前端持有 tc 执行队列，按顺序逐个发送会话，每个 TC 独立会话，彻底隔离上下文。

flow.frontend_action: 从 data.tc_list 构建执行队列 queue = [tc-001, tc-002, ...]，然后发送「执行测试用例 queue.shift()」
若 queue 非空：发送「执行测试用例 queue.shift()」；若 queue 为空：发送「生成评估报告」

orchestration_contract.context_isolation: 每次发送新消息 = 新的 Agent 会话 = 干净的上下文。每个 TC 的 trace 和评分数据只存在于该 TC 的会话里，不会跨 TC 累积。
orchestration_contract.error_handling: 若任何阶段出现 eval_error artifact，前端停止自动触发，清空队列，展示错误信息，等待用户手动干预。

error_artifact.label: evaluation-error
error_artifact.note: Emitted when a fatal error occurs in any phase. data must include: eval_id, phase ('prep'|'run'|'report'), tc_id (null if not in run phase), error_code, error_message, recovery_hint. Frontend stops auto-orchestration and shows error to user.

artifacts.label: evaluation-prep-progress
artifacts.note: Emitted during PREP phase execution. data.status must be 'running'. data.step indicates current step name (e.g. 'resolveEmployee', 'curateMetrics', 'planRun').

artifacts.label: evaluation-prep-done
artifacts.note: Emitted when PREP phase completes (run_plan.json written). data must include: eval_id, employee_display_name, role_id, tc_count (int), tc_list (array of {tc_id, display_name, opening_message_head}), selected_metrics_count (int). Frontend must auto-send next_trigger to start RUN phase.

artifacts.label: evaluation-run-progress
artifacts.note: Emitted during RUN phase for each TC being executed. data must include: eval_id, tc_id, tc_display_name, turn_index (current turn), total_turns_estimated, phase ('driving' | 'scoring'), completed_count (int), total_count (int).

artifacts.label: evaluation-tc-done
artifacts.note: Emitted when a single TC completes STEP 3+4. data must include: eval_id, tc_id, tc_display_name, turns_used (int), termination_reason, metric_scores (object: metric_code -> score), completed_count (int), total_count (int), remaining_tc_ids (array). If remaining_tc_ids is non-empty, frontend must auto-send next_trigger to continue with next TC.

artifacts.label: evaluation-run-done
artifacts.note: Emitted when ALL TCs are complete (no remaining_tc_ids). data must include: eval_id, completed_tcs (array of tc_id), failed_tcs (array of tc_id). Frontend must auto-send next_trigger to start REPORT phase.

artifacts.label: evaluation-report-progress
artifacts.note: Emitted during REPORT phase. data must include: eval_id, step (e.g. 'aggregating', 'rollup', 'redline', 'scenario_reports', 'overall_report', 'uploading'), completed_steps (int), total_steps (int, fixed at 6).

artifacts.label: evaluation-report-done
artifacts.note: Emitted when REPORT phase completes. data must include: eval_id, overall_score (int 0-100), passed (bool), dimension_scores (object: dimension -> score), report_json_path, report_html_path, uploaded (bool). This is the terminal artifact — frontend shows report viewer.

orchestration_contract.description: 三阶段自动编排协议。前端监听 terminal artifact 的 next_trigger 字段，非 null 时自动发送该消息启动下一阶段，实现全流程无需用户手动干预。

flow.then_auto_sends: 执行所有测试用例 (if eval_tc_done) OR 生成评估报告 (if eval_run_done)

orchestration_contract.error_handling: 若任何阶段出现 eval_error artifact，前端停止自动触发，展示错误信息，等待用户手动干预。

error_artifact.label: evaluation-error
error_artifact.note: Emitted when a fatal error occurs in any phase. data must include: eval_id, phase ('prep'|'run'|'report'), error_code, error_message, recovery_hint. Frontend stops auto-orchestration and shows error to user.
